title: 輕軌槽型鋼軌街道整合~Street integration of grooved-rail light rail
focus: 槽型鋼軌輪緣界面排水與街道交通協調~Grooved-rail flange interfaces, drainage and street-traffic coordination
summary: 本課聚焦槽型鋼軌輪緣界面排水與街道交通協調。從輪緣槽幾何誤差預算建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把鋼軌與鋪面自由變形與路面混行的停止距離連成可驗證的介面，最後以街道介面交付案例整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。~This course studies grooved-rail flange interfaces, drainage and street-traffic coordination. Start with flangeway geometry uncertainty budget to define physical or information boundaries, connect free movement of rail and pavement with stopping distance in shared streets as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through street-interface acceptance cases. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
history: 本課以可查核的工程與方法出版歷程建立背景：2006 年公路鐵路交會處的人因指引報告出版。；2019 年公路鐵路平交道手冊第三版出版。；2025 年鐵路可靠度與安全方法第一分冊發布。這些日期分別是工程事件、指南重印或標準研究出版，並非宣稱本課系統在該年問世。對槽型鋼軌輪緣界面排水與街道交通協調而言，歷史脈絡的價值是理解需求如何從單一設備擴展到跨介面證據。本課再用街道集水與排水需求及混行路口車尾清空連結這些方法；代表工程僅提供觀察方向，假想參數不冒充現場資料，歷史版規範也不自動等於當地現行要求。~The background uses checkable project events and methodological publication history. 2006: Human-factors guidance for highway–rail intersections was published. 2019: The third highway–rail crossing handbook edition was published. 2025: A new first part of railway RAMS was published. These dates identify project events, guide reprints, or standards and research publications, rather than claiming that the lesson system first appeared then. For grooved-rail flange interfaces, drainage and street-traffic coordination, the useful historical perspective is the expansion from individual equipment to evidence across interfaces. The course connects that perspective through street runoff and drainage demand and rear clearance at shared intersections. Reference projects guide observation only: hypothetical parameters are not field data, and historical editions do not automatically establish current local requirements.
example: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究輪緣槽幾何誤差預算。原創假想教學輸入：槽形製造誤差界 groove=0.4 mm；輪緣幾何誤差界 flange=0.3 mm；測量誤差界 survey=0.2 mm。公式 y=groove+flange+survey，代入得 y=0.9 mm。邊界：僅合成三個有界誤差，不是實際槽寬、輪緣間隙或允收限值。敏感度只改 groove=0.4 至 0.44 mm，輸出變為 0.94 mm；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究街道集水與排水需求：原創假想教學輸入：假想逕流係數 C=0.7 1；教學降雨強度 i=30 mm/h；集水面積 A=120 m2。公式 y=C*i*A/3600，代入得 y=0.7 L/s。邊界：均勻穩定降雨的簡化需求模型，未求排水容量、集流延遲或淹水水深。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。將槽型製造、輪緣幾何與測量界限分開相加，所得只是誤差預算而非實際槽寬。用斷面圖標明接觸和非接觸位置，避免把範例數值誤作驗收限值。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。~Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate flangeway geometry uncertainty budget. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: groove manufacturing error bound groove=0.4 mm; flange geometry error bound flange=0.3 mm; survey error bound survey=0.2 mm. Formula y=groove+flange+survey gives y=0.9 mm. Boundary: Three bounded errors only, not actual groove width, flange clearance or an acceptance limit. For sensitivity, change only groove=0.4 to 0.44 mm; the output becomes 0.94 mm. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate street runoff and drainage demand: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: assumed runoff coefficient C=0.7 1; teaching rainfall intensity i=30 mm/h; catchment area A=120 m2. Formula y=C*i*A/3600 gives y=0.7 L/s. Boundary: Simple demand under uniform steady rainfall; drain capacity, concentration delay and flood depth are not solved. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Sum manufacturing, flange-geometry and survey bounds as an uncertainty budget rather than an actual groove width. Mark contact and clearance locations on a section sketch without converting example values into acceptance limits. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.

units.anchor: 輪緣槽幾何誤差預算~Flangeway geometry uncertainty budget
units.title: 輪緣槽幾何誤差預算~Flangeway geometry uncertainty budget
units.mechanism: 將槽型製造、輪緣幾何與測量界限分開相加，所得只是誤差預算而非實際槽寬。用斷面圖標明接觸和非接觸位置，避免把範例數值誤作驗收限值。槽形鋼軌與輪緣之間的幾何介面包含製造、磨耗與量測的不確定度。把各個最大誤差同向相加可得到保守的誤差預算，但不能因此推得槽寬、輪緣空間或真正間隙；實際幾何還需要名義尺寸、變形與曲線姿態，而行人和自行車風險屬另一組介面需求。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：僅合成三個有界誤差，不是實際槽寬、輪緣間隙或允收限值。~Sum manufacturing, flange-geometry and survey bounds as an uncertainty budget rather than an actual groove width. Mark contact and clearance locations on a section sketch without converting example values into acceptance limits. The groove–flange interface contains uncertainty from manufacturing, wear and measurement. Adding same-direction maximum error bounds gives a conservative uncertainty budget, not the groove width, flange clearance or actual gap. Real geometry also needs nominal dimensions, deformation and curve attitude. Pedestrian and bicycle risks form a separate set of street-interface requirements. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Three bounded errors only, not actual groove width, flange clearance or an acceptance limit.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：槽形製造誤差界 groove=0.4 mm；輪緣幾何誤差界 flange=0.3 mm；測量誤差界 survey=0.2 mm。公式 y=groove+flange+survey，代入得 y=0.9 mm。邊界：僅合成三個有界誤差，不是實際槽寬、輪緣間隙或允收限值。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: groove manufacturing error bound groove=0.4 mm; flange geometry error bound flange=0.3 mm; survey error bound survey=0.2 mm. Formula y=groove+flange+survey gives y=0.9 mm. Boundary: Three bounded errors only, not actual groove width, flange clearance or an acceptance limit.
units.verify: 以獨立量具核對槽形與輪緣輪廓，在相同座標保留名義尺寸及誤差符號，另檢查測量零點。以「輪緣槽幾何誤差預算」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Check groove and flange profiles with independent gauges, retain nominal dimensions and error signs in one coordinate system, and verify instrument zeros separately. For flangeway geometry uncertainty budget, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 將誤差總和當成實際間隙會省略名義幾何；共用失準量具還可能讓兩個錯誤輪廓看似互相吻合。回到「輪緣槽幾何誤差預算」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Treating an error sum as the actual gap omits nominal geometry; a shared miscalibrated gauge can also make two incorrect profiles appear mutually compatible. Trace the input chain for flangeway geometry uncertainty budget. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 三項誤差界的總和就是現場鋼軌槽內的實際間隙~The sum of three error bounds is the actual clearance inside the rail groove.
units.practice: 只把槽形製造誤差界 groove 從 0.4 改成 0.44 mm（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.9 變為 0.94 mm。先說明「輪緣槽幾何誤差預算」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only groove manufacturing error bound groove from 0.4 to 0.44 mm (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.9 to 0.94 mm. Explain the causal direction for flangeway geometry uncertainty budget, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 街道集水與排水需求~Street runoff and drainage demand
units.title: 街道集水與排水需求~Street runoff and drainage demand
units.mechanism: 先劃定會流向軌槽的集水面積，將雨強、面積與逕流係數放到一致單位。計算結果只是來水需求，仍需另查坡度、堵塞和排水出口能力。降雨逕流需求可由雨強、集水面積與逕流係數估算，毫米乘平方米等於公升。這個需求量尚未描述排水口能力，槽內泥砂、路面坡度和尾水都會影響真正排放；短小雨場的計算也不能代表暴雨頻率與都市集水區的完整水文過程。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：均勻穩定降雨的簡化需求模型，未求排水容量、集流延遲或淹水水深。~Delineate the area draining toward the rail and use consistent rainfall, area and runoff units. The result is inflow demand; slopes, blockage and outlet capacity need separate assessment. Rainfall runoff demand follows intensity, catchment area and a runoff coefficient, with millimetres times square metres giving litres. This demand does not describe inlet capacity. Sediment, pavement slope and tailwater affect actual discharge, while a short simple event cannot represent storm frequency or the full hydrology of an urban catchment. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Simple demand under uniform steady rainfall; drain capacity, concentration delay and flood depth are not solved.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：假想逕流係數 C=0.7 1；教學降雨強度 i=30 mm/h；集水面積 A=120 m2。公式 y=C*i*A/3600，代入得 y=0.7 L/s。邊界：均勻穩定降雨的簡化需求模型，未求排水容量、集流延遲或淹水水深。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: assumed runoff coefficient C=0.7 1; teaching rainfall intensity i=30 mm/h; catchment area A=120 m2. Formula y=C*i*A/3600 gives y=0.7 L/s. Boundary: Simple demand under uniform steady rainfall; drain capacity, concentration delay and flood depth are not solved.
units.verify: 以集水邊界核對面積與降雨單位，在低風險縮尺水槽量測流入及流出，分開記錄槽內暫存水量。以「街道集水與排水需求」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Check catchment boundaries and rainfall units, measure inflow and outflow on a low-risk scale water rig, and record temporary storage separately. For street runoff and drainage demand, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 漏算鄰近路面集水會低估需求，排水口淤塞則會在雨強不變時使暫存水量上升而不改變此公式的需求。回到「街道集水與排水需求」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Omitted adjoining pavement understates demand; a blocked inlet raises storage at unchanged rainfall without changing the demand calculated by this formula. Trace the input chain for street runoff and drainage demand. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 算出的降雨逕流量就等於排水口保證可以排走的流量~Calculated rainfall runoff equals the flow that the drain is guaranteed to remove.
units.practice: 只把教學降雨強度 i 從 30 改成 33 mm/h（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.7 變為 0.77 L/s。先說明「街道集水與排水需求」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only teaching rainfall intensity i from 30 to 33 mm/h (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.7 to 0.77 L/s. Explain the causal direction for street runoff and drainage demand, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 路面與鋼軌測量基準~Street and rail survey reference
units.title: 路面與鋼軌測量基準~Street and rail survey reference
units.mechanism: 把路面標高、軌頂與街道交叉坡放在同一測量基準，避免各專業各自看似合格。比較不同視距的定位誤差，檢查施工移交時是否保留一致控制點。小角度方向誤差會隨視線距離放大成橫向位置誤差，長視線不一定帶來更準的幾何控制。基準網、折光、儀器對中與目標安裝都會影響結果；同一站多次讀值一致，仍可能共同受到基準偏移影響。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：小角近似與單一方向誤差，未含完整測量網平差。~Reference pavement level, rail head and crossfall to one survey datum rather than accepting disconnected discipline checks. Compare sight-distance errors and verify continuity of control points at construction handoff. A small angular error becomes transverse position error proportional to sight distance, so a longer sight is not automatically more accurate. Control networks, refraction, centring and target mounting all matter. Repeated agreement from one station can still share a common datum error. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Small-angle approximation for one direction error, not a complete survey-network adjustment.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：視線距離 distance=40 m；小角誤差 angle=2.5e-05 rad。公式 y=distance*angle*1000，代入得 y=1 mm。邊界：小角近似與單一方向誤差，未含完整測量網平差。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sight distance distance=40 m; small angular error angle=2.5e-05 rad. Formula y=distance*angle*1000 gives y=1 mm. Boundary: Small-angle approximation for one direction error, not a complete survey-network adjustment.
units.verify: 用不同站位與往返觀測交叉核對，將角度誤差、對中誤差與基準移動分列。以「路面與鋼軌測量基準」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Cross-check from different stations and reciprocal observations, separating angular error, centring and datum movement. For street and rail survey reference, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 儀器重複性良好可能掩蓋穩定的對中偏差，熱折光則使日夜結果有系統差異。回到「路面與鋼軌測量基準」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Good repeatability can conceal stable centring bias; thermal refraction can create systematic day-night differences. Trace the input chain for street and rail survey reference. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 同一站位重複量測完全一致就能保證絕對位置正確~Identical repeated observations from one station guarantee correct absolute position.
units.practice: 只把視線距離 distance 從 40 改成 44 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 1 變為 1.1 mm。先說明「路面與鋼軌測量基準」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only sight distance distance from 40 to 44 m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 1 to 1.1 mm. Explain the causal direction for street and rail survey reference, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 鋼軌與鋪面自由變形~Free movement of rail and pavement
units.title: 鋼軌與鋪面自由變形~Free movement of rail and pavement
units.mechanism: 先算鋼軌自由熱伸長，再討論周邊鋪面和固定條件如何限制這個位移。接縫看不出移動仍可能累積內力，量測需同時保留溫度與邊界狀態。自由熱伸長與原長、膨脹係數及溫差成正比，但受拘束後伸長會被轉成內力。接縫、支承與鄰接構件共同決定這種轉換；因此同一個溫差可能在自由端表現為位移，在固定端表現為應力，不能用一種量測代替另一種。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：均勻溫度與自由伸長；不包含熱梯度引起的彎曲。~Calculate free rail expansion before discussing restraint from pavement and fixings. Little visible joint movement may coexist with internal force, so retain temperature and boundary-condition records together. Free thermal expansion scales with length, coefficient and temperature change, while restraint converts some expansion into force. Joints, supports and adjoining members govern that conversion. The same temperature change can produce movement at a free end and stress at a restrained end, so one measurement cannot replace the other. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Uniform temperature and free expansion; thermal-gradient bending is omitted.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：構件長度 L=30 m；膨脹係數 alpha=1.2e-05 1/K；溫度變化 dT=20 K。公式 y=L*alpha*dT*1000，代入得 y=7.2 mm。邊界：均勻溫度與自由伸長；不包含熱梯度引起的彎曲。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: member length L=30 m; expansion coefficient alpha=1.2e-05 1/K; temperature change dT=20 K. Formula y=L*alpha*dT*1000 gives y=7.2 mm. Boundary: Uniform temperature and free expansion; thermal-gradient bending is omitted.
units.verify: 以多點溫度檢查均勻假設，再對照端點位移與支承狀態，分辨自由與拘束行為。以「鋼軌與鋪面自由變形」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Check temperature uniformity at several points and compare end movement with support condition to distinguish free and restrained behaviour. For free movement of rail and pavement, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 支承卡住可能讓位移很小但內力增加，日照溫差又可能造成彎曲而非單純伸長。回到「鋼軌與鋪面自由變形」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~A seized support can suppress movement while increasing force; solar gradients may cause bending rather than simple extension. Trace the input chain for free movement of rail and pavement. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 量不到熱伸長就表示構件完全沒有熱應力~No measured thermal expansion means that a member has no thermal stress.
units.practice: 只把構件長度 L 從 30 改成 33 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 7.2 變為 7.92 mm。先說明「鋼軌與鋪面自由變形」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only member length L from 30 to 33 m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 7.2 to 7.92 mm. Explain the causal direction for free movement of rail and pavement, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 街道曲線的側向加速度~Lateral acceleration on street curves
units.title: 街道曲線的側向加速度~Lateral acceleration on street curves
units.mechanism: 以車速平方和曲線半徑比較側向加速度量級，不把結果當成輪緣力或脫軌判定。再辨認超高、車體姿態和輪軌接觸是這個簡式未處理的部分。曲線向心加速度與速度平方成正比、與半徑成反比，導向輪與懸吊需共同提供相應作用。傾斜或超高可改變乘客感受的側向分量，但不會消除車輛轉彎所需的向心加速度；轉折處的變化率亦影響舒適。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：平面定速圓曲線，不含超高、傾斜與過渡曲線。~Compare lateral-acceleration scale using speed squared and curve radius without equating it to flange force or derailment assessment. Identify cant, body attitude and contact behaviour as omitted mechanisms. Centripetal acceleration scales with speed squared and inverse radius, supplied through guidance and suspension forces. Tilt or banking changes the lateral component felt by passengers but does not remove the acceleration needed to turn. Its rate of change through transitions also affects comfort. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant-speed planar circular curve, excluding cant, tilt and transition geometry.

units.anchor: 軌槽輪廓磨耗趨勢~Groove-profile wear trends
units.title: 軌槽輪廓磨耗趨勢~Groove-profile wear trends
units.mechanism: 固定同一斷面與量測方向比較磨耗深度，先排除測點變動造成的假趨勢。短期線性率只用於相同工況的近程比較，路口污染和潤滑改變後需重新檢查。線性磨耗率可以作短區間履歷比較，但磨耗機制可能隨潤滑、負載與表面狀態改變。早期磨合與後期疲勞不一定沿同一斜率；把短期平均率外推到全壽命，容易忽略加速劣化及偶發損傷。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定工況短區間線性外推，不是剩餘壽命保證。~Compare wear at a fixed section and direction to exclude false trends from changed measurement positions. Use linear rates only for short similar-condition comparisons and reassess after contamination or lubrication changes. A linear wear rate supports short-interval history comparisons, but lubrication, load and surface state can change the mechanism. Running-in and later fatigue need not share one slope. Extrapolating a short average across a whole life can miss accelerating deterioration and incidental damage. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Short-range linear extrapolation at fixed conditions, not a remaining-life guarantee.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：觀察磨耗深度 depth=0.6 mm；觀察循環數 cycles=30000 cycles；外推循環數 future=10000 cycles。公式 y=depth/cycles*future，代入得 y=0.2 mm。邊界：固定工況短區間線性外推，不是剩餘壽命保證。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: observed wear depth depth=0.6 mm; observed cycles cycles=30000 cycles; extrapolated cycles future=10000 cycles. units.anchor: 路面混行的停止距離~Stopping distance in shared streets
units.title: 路面混行的停止距離~Stopping distance in shared streets
units.mechanism: 將反應距離與制動距離分開，觀察速度增加時第二項的平方效應。濕滑路面和軌面黏著另作情境限制，不把平直定減速度模型直接用於街道配置。停止距離由反應期間的等速前進與制動期間的動能消散相加。速度增加會同時增加兩項，而減速度只影響第二項；把控制命令發出時間當成制動力建立時間會漏掉一段距離。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：平直路線、定減速度、無輪滑；未含坡度、黏著變動或制動建立曲線。~Separate reaction and braking travel to observe the square-speed contribution. Treat wet pavement and rail adhesion as separate scenario limits rather than designing a street from a level constant-deceleration model. Stopping distance combines constant-speed travel during response with kinetic-energy removal during braking. Speed changes both contributions, whereas deceleration changes only the second. A command timestamp is not the instant at which the full braking force becomes available. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Level track, constant deceleration and no slip; gradients, adhesion variation and brake build-up curves are excluded.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：初速 v=20 m/s；定減速度大小 a=0.8 m/s2；反應時間 tau=1.5 s。公式 y=v*tau+v*v/(2*a)，代入得 y=280 m。邊界：平直路線、定減速度、無輪滑；未含坡度、黏著變動或制動建立曲線。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: initial speed v=20 m/s; constant deceleration magnitude a=0.8 m/s2; response time tau=1.5 s. Formula y=v*tau+v*v/(2*a) gives y=280 m. Boundary: Level track, constant deceleration and no slip; gradients, adhesion variation and brake build-up curves are excluded.

units.anchor: 路口提示與察覺距離~Junction warnings and reaction travel
units.title: 路口提示與察覺距離~Junction warnings and reaction travel
units.mechanism: 把看見提示、理解意義和開始動作列成不同事件，避免只量按鍵反應。以不同假想行進速度換算這段時間消耗的距離，保留道路使用者能力差異。反應期間移動距離由速度乘反應時間決定，這段距離在任何制動能力發揮前已經消耗。察覺、理解與動作不是同一時刻，介面可讀性和預期程度會改變反應；把受訓受試者的最佳表現當作所有人的固定值會低估需求。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：等速反應距離的原創假設，不是道路或鐵道的正式設計視距。~Separate seeing, understanding and acting instead of measuring only a button response. Convert that interval into travel at hypothetical speeds while retaining differences between road users. Distance during reaction is speed times reaction time and is consumed before braking can take effect. Detection, interpretation and action are separate moments influenced by readability and expectation. The best performance of a trained participant is not a fixed value applicable to everyone. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant-speed reaction-distance teaching assumption, not an official road or railway sight-distance requirement.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：接近速度 v=16 m/s；假想反應時間 reaction=2.5 s。公式 y=v*reaction，代入得 y=40 m。邊界：等速反應距離的原創假設，不是道路或鐵道的正式設計視距。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: approach speed v=16 m/s; assumed reaction time reaction=2.5 s. units.anchor: 混行路口車尾清空~Rear clearance at shared intersections
units.title: 混行路口車尾清空~Rear clearance at shared intersections
units.mechanism: 清空距離必須追蹤車尾離開衝突區，不是車頭通過停止線便完成。以離線時空圖核對低速長車與等待因素，避免將教學秒數當成號誌時制。道路車輛清空時間從開始等待到車尾完全離開衝突區計算，距離必須包含車長而不能只看車頭的位置。定速度估算只展示等待與移動兩部分，長車起步、轉彎和下游阻塞可能改變速度；鄰近號誌的放行並不保證車尾已有足夠可用空間。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定車速與固定起步等待的桌面教學模型，未含加速、坡度、轉彎或現場警示設定。~Track the rear leaving the conflict area rather than only the front crossing a line. Use an offline time-distance chart for slow long vehicles and waiting without adopting teaching seconds as signal timings. Road-vehicle clearance runs from initial waiting until the rear leaves the conflict area, so the distance must include vehicle length rather than front position alone. Constant speed separates waiting and movement conceptually. Long-vehicle acceleration, turning and downstream blockage alter speed; a nearby green indication does not establish adequate space for the vehicle rear. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Desktop constant-speed model with fixed startup waiting, excluding acceleration, gradient, turning and field-warning settings.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：車尾需行進的清空距離 distance=30 m；假想定車速 speed=2 m/s；起步等待 wait=4 s。公式 y=distance/speed+wait，代入得 y=19 s。邊界：定車速與固定起步等待的桌面教學模型，未含加速、坡度、轉彎或現場警示設定。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: rear-end clearance travel distance=30 m; assumed constant vehicle speed speed=2 m/s; startup waiting wait=4 s. Formula y=distance/speed+wait gives y=19 s. Boundary: Desktop constant-speed model with fixed startup waiting, excluding acceleration, gradient, turning and field-warning settings.

units.anchor: 街道介面交付案例~Street-interface acceptance cases
units.title: 街道介面交付案例~Street-interface acceptance cases
units.mechanism: 把軌槽幾何、排水、行人穿越與道路資訊分成可追溯的測試需求，避免只驗證列車能通過。對跨單位交接保留版本和條件，清楚列出尚未涵蓋的街道情境。測試覆蓋率只對已定義的分母有意義。需求、狀態、轉移與危害各有不同分母，執行很多正常案例仍可能漏掉罕見但重要的交接；同一案例重跑多次不會自動增加獨立需求的覆蓋。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。~Trace groove geometry, drainage, pedestrian crossing and road information to separate test requirements rather than checking only train passage. Retain handoff versions, conditions and street scenarios still untested. Coverage is meaningful only relative to its defined denominator. Requirements, states, transitions and hazards have different denominators. Many normal cases can still omit a rare but important handoff, and repeating one case does not automatically cover additional independent requirements. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure.

units.failure: 縮小分母可讓覆蓋率看似提高，重複案例也可能掩蓋邊界狀態根本未被執行。回到「街道介面交付案例」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Shrinking the denominator makes coverage look better; duplicate cases can hide boundary states that were never exercised. Trace the input chain for street-interface acceptance cases. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險~One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.
units.practice: 只把已執行案例 tested 從 72 改成 73 cases（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.8 變為 0.811111 1。先說明「街道介面交付案例」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only executed cases tested from 72 to 73 cases (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.8 to 0.811111 1. Explain the causal direction for street-interface acceptance cases, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
